text: Physical newlines shall be LF or CRLF, with CRLF counted once. A standalone CR shall be rejected. Outside strings/comments, horizontal whitespace shall consist only of ASCII space and tab. Indentation shall have no syntactic effect.
clause_basis: Conservative sentence/semicolon seed groups; semantic clause review required before closure.
